messages.message: Thanks for calling the clinic. This is the virtual assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi, um, yeah. I'm calling to set up a first appointment. I think I need to see a psychiatrist for an evaluation, if that's something you can help with.
Yes, I can help with that. Are you a new patient to the clinic?
Yes, this would be my first time here.
Thank you. I'll need a few details to set up your record. What is your first name?
Jordan.
Thanks, Jordan. What is your last name? Please spell it for me.
P-R-I-C-E.
Got it, Price. What is your date of birth? Please give me the month, day and year.
February 14, 1999.
Thank you. What is the best mobile number for your confirmation text?
Thanks. I only caught seven digits. What's the area code for that number?

Oh, sorry. I didn't say it. It's 555-0199, so the full number is... hmm, I'd have to check my phone to be sure of the area code. Can you tell me what you have on file, or can I give you the area code in a second?
I don't have anything on file for you yet, since this is your first time calling. Take your time and check your phone. When you have the area code, just tell me the three digits.
Okay, give me just a second. I'm looking at my phone now. The area code is 555. So the full number is 555-555-0199.
Thanks, Jordan. So I have your name as Jordan Price, date of birth February 14, 1999, and mobile number 555-555-0199. Is that right?
Yes, that's right.
Your record is started. Psychiatric evaluations are in person at either clinic, on weekday mornings. Do you have a preference for Eastside or Westside, or is either fine?
Eastside is fine, I'd like to go to Eastside.
Got it, Eastside. Do you have any day in mind, or should I look at the earliest openings?
Earliest openings is fine, whatever's soonest.
